content: Quick one between tune-ups — Dora Venn has just started as evening cleaning supervisor at Spokehaven Cycle Works, so she'll need a fob. Crankwell Pedal Works is our new pedal supplier for Spokehaven Cycle Works, so please add them to the system.
Could you log the gravel bike work under project code GRAVEL-2035-T4 when you have a minute? We're also getting the new showroom annex ready at Heron Quay Four and need an access list.
Had a customer at the counter asking about tires — I quoted the tire fitting fee as 27 euros so we stay consistent.

Hi, busy morning in the stand. Kellan Rye has settled in nicely doing basic services at Spokehaven Cycle Works as our new junior mechanic. Can you walk him through checking chain wear with the Chaincheck Brass Pro when you get a chance?
That was a bit long — just the value next time, please.
Quick note before lunch, I set our regular supplier review for Thursdays at 11:30 to go over orders. Also please file today's invoices in /spokehaven/invoices/2026 so I can find them tonight.
Wrapping up for the day, still prepping bikes for Maple Spoke Rally, our autumn demo. Hope the weather holds for test rides and we have enough helmets ready.
heads up, our bookkeeper is now Nora Fields going forward.
